description: This file defines a Java class 'Eclipse' that generates an Eclipse project configuration, specifically an '.classpath' file, based on certain project settings and source roots.

classes.name: Eclipse
classes.description: A utility class for generating Eclipse project configuration files (.classpath) from a given project configuration.

classes.name: Eclipse.Bucket
classes.description: A nested helper class used to group source roots based on matching patterns, aiding in the ordering of source directories in the generated classpath.

methods.name: generateFrom
methods.description: Main method that generates the '.classpath' content based on the provided Configuration object.

methods.name: constructExcluding
methods.description: Constructs an 'excluding' attribute for source roots to specify nested or excluded directories.

methods.description: Returns the path of a File object without the leading './'.
